ceiling_statement: Maximum achievable contradiction/uncertainty/coverage/blind-spot handling under H1-H8 is trichotomous certified totality: every query against the committed corpus and rulebase returns exactly one of {PASS with recomputable certificate, FAIL/CONTRADICTION with recomputable counter-certificate, typed UNKNOWN carrying a machine-readable reason drawn from a CLOSED, committed enumeration of unknowability causes} — where (a) contradiction detection is provably complete WITHIN a declared decidable class over the committed inputs, (b) the boundary of that class is itself a committed, certificate-carrying, machine-enforced artifact (not prose), (c) coverage is a positively-proven census (absence of a check is itself a detectable, blocking state — no silent gap), and (d) UNKNOWN is a terminal object: no operation maps it to pass/equality (H2) and any flagged anomaly is a blocking, non-servable state (H3). No feasible system can additionally certify the absence of unknown-unknowns outside its committed input set, or decide consistency of theories beyond its declared decidable class.
derivation: (1) Computability: consistency of an unrestricted first-order theory is undecidable (and by Gödel II, an expressive consistent system cannot prove its own consistency), so 'detects all contradictions' is impossible simpliciter for ANY system; the supremum is completeness within a declared decidable class plus a checkable declaration of that class's boundary. (2) Information theory: blind spots over inputs never received are undetectable in principle — no computation over received bytes can bound properties of unreceived bytes; hence the ceiling for blind-spot handling is not 'no blind spots' but 'no SILENT blind spots over the committed universe': a positively-proven coverage census in which every element of the committed corpus is either checked (with certificate) or explicitly enumerated as unchecked (blocking or typed-UNKNOWN), so that within the commitment, unaccounted state is structurally impossible. This is the exact dual of a fail-open gate: absence of proof must be distinguishable from proof of absence, and only the committed universe admits that distinction. (3) Consistency/verification theory: a false-green (claiming coverage or consistency not actually recomputed) is excluded only by H8 recompute-and-compare — a declared 'all clear' can never exceed what an independent recomputation over committed inputs establishes. Therefore trichotomous certified totality with a closed UNKNOWN-reason enumeration and a positively-proven census is the ceiling; every stronger claim collides with undecidability (b), unreceived-input opacity (2), or producer-trust (3). This argument is model-independent — it holds for any system whatsoever satisfying H1-H8.
attainment_mechanism: B0 is nearest the ceiling here (map section 2 lists AX-09 as a leading axis) and every ceiling component has an existing seat: the un-gameable positive-proof pattern of authority-v2/proofs/verify-proof-manifest.py + authority-v2/run-proofs.sh (a crash yields no manifest, never a false green) is exactly clause (c); fail-hard NFC/canonical-literal rejection in systems/orchestrator-omega-modules/rdf-canonicalization.lisp and the honest-ceiling judges (systems/orchestrator-cli/deontic-gate.lisp, inference-gate.lisp, jurisprudence-judge.lisp) already type UNKNOWN as a first-class verdict. Ceiling completion, all in today's SBCL: (i) compile the epistemic-boundary declarations of systems/orchestrator-epistemic/meta-ontology.lisp (doesNotResolveConflicts / doesNotSelectInterpretation, lines 122-168) from RDF prose into a closed Lisp sum type of UNKNOWN reasons — a defstruct hierarchy consumed only through exhaustive etypecase so an unenumerated reason is a compile-visible/fail-closed error, making clause (d)'s closed enumeration structural; (ii) make source/anomaly-detection.lisp's queue a blocking transition — a flagged anomaly writes a non-servable marker checked by the constitutional barrier (source/constitutional-gate.lisp), so serving flagged state becomes impossible rather than discouraged; (iii) extend systems/orchestrator-epistemic/artifact-census.lisp with a per-check coverage manifest (check-id × artifact-id matrix) hashed into the proof manifest, so an unchecked committed artifact is a positively detected FAIL; (iv) run the deterministic pairwise conflict core source/legal-conflict-resolution.lisp exhaustively over the committed rulebase (finite, hence decidable) emitting a counter-certificate per detected conflict. SHA-256 commitments + pure CL — no new tooling.
b0_gap: B0 map AX-09 row + section 3: the epistemic-boundary declarations are 'RDF prose NOT machine-enforced' — the boundary of the decidable class exists as honest documentation, not as the committed, enforced artifact clause (b) requires; the anomaly and AST gates are 'advisory, not blocking', violating clause (d)'s non-servable requirement; there is no closed enumeration of UNKNOWN reasons (UNKNOWN verdicts exist per-judge but their causes are not a committed sum type); and per the AX-10 residual, omega's use-default/use-default-content restarts (systems/orchestrator-omega-modules/frbr-conditions.lisp) inject synthesized content and continue — a silent-degradation path that is precisely the silent blind spot the ceiling makes structurally impossible.
lean_obligation: Fix a finite committed universe U (artifacts + rules), a finite check family C, a decidable conflict predicate conflict : Rule -> Rule -> Bool, and a closed inductive type `UnknownReason` (unformalizedSource | contestedInterpretation | missingInput | outOfDeclaredClass | flaggedAnomaly). Define verdict V : Query -> Verdict where Verdict := pass Cert | fail Cert | unknown UnknownReason. Prove: (T1) totality — V is a total function (no query lacks a verdict); (T2) certificate soundness — pass/fail certificates re-verify under the independent checker (recompute-and-compare, zero producer trust); (T3) in-class completeness — for every pair (r1, r2) in the committed rulebase, conflict r1 r2 = true implies V returns fail with a counter-certificate naming (r1, r2) (exhaustive detection within the decidable class); (T4) census positivity — for every (c, u) ∈ C × U, the coverage matrix contains exactly one of {checked-with-cert, enumerated-unchecked}, and a missing entry is unrepresentable in the manifest type (no silent gap, by construction); (T5) UNKNOWN terminality — no function in the trusted API maps `unknown r` to `pass` (stated as: the pass-introduction rules of the Verdict algebra never take an unknown argument — a typing theorem). All five are statements over finite decidable structures, directly formalizable in Lean 4.
